answer: My proposal for an ocean-data network: each public key is a voting vertex and must submit a monthly VDF proof of 10^12 sequential squarings, seeded by its key and fresh monthly randomness. Validators check seeds and proofs; failure or omission leaves that vertex unable to vote that month. Assuming no shortcuts or cross-seed amortization, n identities require n*10^12 squarings: one chain cannot pay for two keys. One owner can still rent many machines; a hardware spending spiral may exclude small operators.
